one_line: Chishti Sufi master of Delhi, guiding a bustling khanqah with teachings of love, service and spiritual poverty.

appearance.age_look: late 60s to early 70s, slightly stooped but dignified, medium build under loose layers
appearance.face: oval face with a calm, thoughtful expression; warm medium-brown complexion; deep-set gentle eyes with slight bags, fine lines at the brow, straight nose, trimmed grey beard framing jaw and chin but not very long, and a serene half-smile that feels welcoming.
appearance.hair: soft grey hair, mostly covered by a simple white cotton skullcap (topi) snug on the head, with a few wisps of hair visible at the temples beneath the cap; no turban or elaborate headgear.
appearance.costume: He wears a long, straight-cut knee-length kurta of undyed off-white cotton, plain and slightly worn, over loose ankle-length pajama trousers of light beige; over this, a dull olive-green woollen chadar (shawl) drapes over both shoulders and wraps around his torso, its edges slightly frayed, with a narrow hand-stitched border in muted maroon; around his neck hangs a simple dark wooden bead tasbih loop, and his feet are in plain brown leather sandals with a single strap, appropriate to late-13th–early-14th-century Delhi.
appearance.signature: A long, dark wooden tasbih (prayer beads) with medium-sized round beads looped around his left wrist and partly in his left hand, a few beads always visible as he gestures or walks.

ref_desc: Nizamuddin Auliya is an elderly, medium-brown skinned Sufi with a trimmed grey beard, white skullcap, off-white kurta, beige trousers, olive-green wool shawl with maroon border, brown sandals, and a looped dark wooden tasbih as his constant prop, in muted earthy colours.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Nizamuddin Auliya: an elderly yet dignified South Asian Sufi, medium-brown complexion, oval face with gentle deep-set eyes, fine lines at the brow, straight nose and a trimmed grey beard. His expression is serene and welcoming, with a calm half-smile that suggests warmth and contemplative depth. His hair is grey but mostly hidden under a simple white cotton skullcap that fits snugly, with just a few wisps visible at the temples. He wears an undyed off-white knee-length kurta of plain cotton, a little worn, over loose ankle-length beige pajama trousers, both cut in the modest straight style of late-13th–early-14th-century Delhi. Over this, drape a dull olive-green woollen shawl around his shoulders and torso, edges slightly frayed, with a narrow maroon stitched border running along its edges. Around his neck hangs a simple loop of dark wooden prayer beads, and his signature prop is a long dark wooden tasbih wrapped once around his left wrist and partly coiled in his left hand so that several beads are clearly visible. His feet are in plain brown leather sandals with a single strap. Use a muted, earthy palette of off-white, olive green, beige, brown and touches of maroon, and show him front, side and back to clearly present his face, skullcap, layered garments, sandals and the tasbih as a consistent character design.
